messages:
Samir (Account Exec): Hey team — handing off Magnolia (SaaS customer, ~250 seats) to CSM. Quick context: closed 2025-01-10, go-live target 2025-02-20, committed to Dedicated plan with 4 reserved GPUs. They run heavy embedding workloads, spike in morning batch windows. Renewal: 12/2025, likely upsell if perf meets SLOs, but they're nervous about initial latency during batch jobs.
Tess (CSM): Thanks Samir. I'll take point. Key risks?
Samir (Account Exec): Risk 1: initial inference latency at 99p could be above target due to long sequences. Risk 2: SSO/SCIM not yet tested. Risk 3: data residency constraints -> needs EU region. Contacts: Daniel (Magnolia infra) <dmagnolia@example.com>, Priya (AI Lead) <priya@magnolia.com>.
Nora (Onboarding Lead): I'll schedule the pre-launch runbook review. Need access to their VPN jump host and sample payloads. Samir — can you share dataset sizes and sample prompt distribution?
Samir (Account Exec): Sending sample payloads now via email. Typical batch: 10k docs/day, avg tokens per doc 1200, 95% short queries under 200 tokens, but nightly re-embedding job hits long sequences.
Tess (CSM): Action items:
- Tess: kickoff meeting with Magnolia + internal: onboarding + eng support (owner: Tess)
- Nora: test SCIM + SSO integration (owner: Nora)
- Jordan: preprod perf run, focus on KV cache and batching config (owner: Jordan)
- Maya: mark renewal as monitor (owner: Maya)
Jordan (Support Engineer): I'll run a perf sweep on dedicated-4g config. Please upload representative payloads to /shared/magnolia/onboarding. Also add expected RPS and p95 latency SLOs.
Tess (CSM): SLOs: p95 < 450ms for interactive, batch throughput 200 req/s, target cost < $0.02/token-equivalent. I'll confirm with customer.
Jordan (Support Engineer): Got it. I'll start with quantized model variants (int8) + batching window 40ms. Will post logs here.
redwood-deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: onboarding-k8s/namespace=magnolia at 2025-01-30T03:00Z by Nora
Nora (Onboarding Lead): Confirmed. I'll provision a preprod stack in EU-west-1 and run SCIM smoke test by 2025-01-28.
Samir (Account Exec): FYI — customer asked about fallback model if dedicated capacity is saturated. Suggest we enable automatic routing to hosted with cost alert. Tess — can you propose policy?
Tess (CSM): Draft routing policy below, will refine after internal review:
```
- fallback: hosted
- max_fallback_tokens_per_day: 2_000_000
- notify: magnolia-contacts + oncall-support
- autoscale_alert: queue_length > 500 for 5m
- cost_cap: $15k/month
```
Tess (CSM): I'll share a doc with details and a proposed rollback plan by EOD.
Maya (Renewals): Noted renewal window. I'll set a 90/60/30 cadence for business reviews and tie feature adoption metrics. Also capture NPS baseline during onboarding.
Jordan (Support Engineer): Uploading perf artifacts: https://redwood.internal/snapshots/magnolia/2025-01-21. Starting perf jobs against dedicated-4g now; will post p95/p99 traces.
Samir (Account Exec): Thanks all. Next: Tess to schedule kickoff, Nora to provision EU stack, Jordan to run perf. Reopen if anything else.
Tess (CSM): On it. I'll DM Daniel to get access and propose meeting times. :calendar:
Samir (Account Exec): :thumbsup:
